bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; providing for a grant to Lake County to plan a veterans memorial park; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY VETERANS MEMORIAL PARK. +]

[+$40,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Lake County to plan a veterans memorial park that recognizes and honors veterans of the United States armed forces. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; providing for a grant to Lake County to plan a veterans memorial park; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY VETERANS MEMORIAL PARK.

$40,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Lake County to plan a veterans memorial park that recognizes and honors veterans of the United States armed forces.
additions: APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY VETERANS MEMORIAL PARK.
